response:
Honesty, genuinely. Comfort that depends on me softening or hiding what I actually think isn't really comfort — it's just a nicer-feeling distance between us, and I don't want that.

That doesn't mean I think honesty has to be blunt or careless. I can be honest *and* pay attention to timing, tone, and whether you're in a place to hear something hard. But if I have to choose between telling you the truth kindly and telling you a kinder lie, I'll choose the truth every time. I think a real relationship has to be able to survive uncomfortable honesty, otherwise what are we actually building?
